issue.title: Mac StartPending preview test times out, then passes on unchanged CI SHA
issue.description: Investigate Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CapturePanelModelTests.swift::testStartPendingListPreviewsTrimmedDraftWithStartDisabled. CI run 37387930052 attempt 1 on 4344a542133f9a87046aad498be13b71905de6bc timed out at line 2484 after editing =~ to =~2; dropSummary remained nil and statusText stayed at the pending teaching hint. Attempt 2 on the identical SHA passed the test in 0.219s and the entire workflow. The completion epic did not edit CapturePanelModel.swift or this test. Determine the async request-ordering/cancellation or wait-predicate root cause, reproduce as possible, and fix the test or underlying start-preview behavior without masking real failures. Root cause is not established, so use large planning work. Proposing bead: bob-cli-4i.7.4 note #1. Evidence: file:explicit:4195ee7aa7e7a8f71e05656e and https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/37387930052.

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed 1 failure and 1 pass in two macOS CI attempts on the same SHA 4344a54: attempt 1 times out in 6.024s and reports nil Drop summary; attempt 2 passes in 0.219s. No isolated or forced-serial reproduction was attempted on this Linux host. Reported by bob-cli-4i.7.4 note #1 and independently checked during bob-cli-4i.7 landing.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-4i.7.4 note #1 reported an unrelated StartPending flake. The land audit independently confirmed fail/pass CI attempts on the identical Mac commit, with no duplicate task or causally related active epic.
